units.text: EA has no PC build of this game for Porthole to download.
contexts: case .noBuild: return "EA has no PC build of this game for Porthole to download."

units.text: The game's files downloaded, but they do not say which program starts the game (__Installer/installerdata.xml). Add the game with + and choose its .exe.
contexts: case .noLauncher: return "The game's files downloaded, but they do not say which program starts the game (__Installer/installerdata.xml). Add the game with + and choose its .exe."

units.text: EA did not give this game a licence (\(reason)). Check that your account owns it and try again.
contexts: case .license(let reason): return "EA did not give this game a licence (\(reason)). Check that your account owns it and try again."

units.text: signed-out
contexts: case .signedOut: return "signed-out"

units.text: graphql
contexts: case .graphQL: return "graphql"

units.text: invalid-\(what)
contexts: case .invalid(let what): return "invalid-\(what)"

units.text: no-build
contexts: case .noBuild: return "no-build"

units.text: no-launcher
contexts: case .noLauncher: return "no-launcher"

units.text: license-\(reason)
contexts: case .license(let reason): return "license-\(reason)"

units.text: https://signin.ea.com
contexts: guard !location.hasPrefix("https://signin.ea.com") else { throw EAAPIError.invalid("exchange-signin") }

units.text: exchange-\(responseType)
contexts: throw EAAPIError.invalid("exchange-\(responseType)")

units.text: error_description
contexts: messages = ["error", "error_description"].compactMap { json[$0] as? String }

units.text: message=\"\(text.prefix(300))\"
contexts: return " message=\"\(text.prefix(300))\""

units.text: unknown error
contexts: let message = (first["message"] as? String) ?? "unknown error"

units.text: HTTP \(http.statusCode)
contexts: throw EAAPIError.license("HTTP \(http.statusCode)")

units.text: X-Signature
contexts: guard let signature = http.value(forHTTPHeaderField: "X-Signature") else { throw EAAPIError.license("no signature") }

units.text: no signature
contexts: guard let signature = http.value(forHTTPHeaderField: "X-Signature") else { throw EAAPIError.license("no signature") }
